issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Outcome
products.tagline: Turn your content into a personal outcome for every lead
products.summaryZh: 将您的内容转化为每位潜在客户的个性化成果
products.descriptionZh: Outcome帮助创作者将内容和专业知识转化为个性化漏斗，这些漏斗能倾听、理解并为每个潜在客户提供有用的结果。不同于向所有人发送相同的引流产品或将其归入预设的测验结果分类，Outcome漏斗利用每个人的回答，结合创作者的内容、知识和流程，生成为其量身定制的内容——如行动计划、审计、评分、路线图、推荐等。
products.description: Outcome helps creators turn their content and expertise into personalized funnels that listen, understand, and deliver a useful outcome to every lead. Instead of sending everyone the same lead magnet or placing them into a predefined quiz result bucket, an Outcome Funnel uses each person’s answers together with the creator’s content, knowledge, and process to generate something made for them - an action plan, audit, score, roadmap, recommendation, and more.

products.name: BrowserAct Cloud
products.tagline: Scrape any data from any website with one prompt
products.summaryZh: 使用一个提示词，从任何网站抓取任何数据。
products.descriptionZh: 别再修修补补那些坏掉的爬虫了。BrowserAct的AI代理能根据你的自然语言描述构建一个Bot，在真实浏览器中测试，并在网站变化时保持其持续运行。结构化数据会直接进入你的CSV、JSON、API，或诸如Make、n8n和Zapier等工具中。一次构建，稳定运行，持续改进。
products.description: Stop fixing broken scrapers. BrowserAct's AI agent builds a Bot from your plain-English description, tests it in a real browser, and keeps it running even when the site changes. Structured data lands in your CSV, JSON, API, or tools like Make, n8n, and Zapier.Build once. Run reliably. Improve continuously.

products.name: Freebuff
products.tagline: Free coding agents to kill Claude, Cursor, Replit, and Devin
products.summaryZh: 免费编码代理，取代Claude、Cursor、Replit和Devin
products.descriptionZh: Freebuff 是一款免费的编程代理，让你能够使用最优秀的开源模型。我们提供命令行工具、桌面应用、网页应用构建器以及云端代理——全部免费！这是构建全栈应用的免费途径。无需订阅，无需 API 密钥，无锁定限制。取消你对 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Lovable、Replit、Bolt、Windsurf 和 Devin 的订阅吧。
products.description: Freebuff is a free coding agent that gives you access to the best open source models. We offer a CLI, Desktop app, Web app builder, and Cloud agent -- all free! This is the free way to build full-stack apps. No subscription, no API keys, no lock-in. Cancel your subscriptions to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Lovable, Replit, Bolt, Windsurf, and Devin.

products.name: Gemini 3.7 Flash
products.tagline: Google's smartest workhorse yet for coding & agents
products.summaryZh: 谷歌迄今最智能的编程与智能体工作利器
products.descriptionZh: 今天，我们在广受欢迎的Flash系列基础上更进一步，推出Gemini 3.7 Flash，这是我们迄今为止在编程和智能体领域最智能的主力模型。
products.description: Today, we’re building on the progress of our widely used Flash series by introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash, our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents.

products.name: Munder Difflin
products.tagline: Make clones with Claude Code and Codex to do your work
products.summaryZh: 使用Claude Code和Codex创建克隆来替你完成工作
products.descriptionZh: [开源] 本地多智能体框架，可封装您已付费的编码代理（如Claude Code和Codex），在“办公室”风格模拟中运行一个全天候为您工作的常驻代理团队。担任这间办公室的老板，或在您不在时让您的克隆体代为管理。适用于开发者、产品经理、设计师、创始人、销售、市场、法务、人力资源或任何从事技术工作的人士。
products.description: [Open-Source] Local Multi Agent Harness that wraps around coding agents you already pay for like Claude Code and Codex to run an office of forever running agents working for you 24/7 in "the office" styled simulation. Be the boss of this office or let your clone be the boss when you are not available. For Developers, Product Managers, Designers, Founders, Sales, Marketing, Legal, HR or anyone who works in tech.

products.name: DeepSeek Harness
products.tagline: Composable agent harness where everything is a plugin
products.summaryZh: 可组合的智能体框架，一切皆为插件。
products.descriptionZh: DeepSeek Harness 是一个开源代理运行时，其中模型、工具、提示、存储、代理循环乃至用户界面均为插件。您可以组合配置文件和代理预设，执行编程式工具调用，并保留完整事件日志以支持恢复与重放。
products.description: DeepSeek Harness is an open-source agent runtime where models, tools, prompts, storage, the agent loop, and even the UI are plugins. You compose profiles and agent presets, run programmatic tool calling, and keep a full event log for recovery and replay.

products.name: isolate.video
products.tagline: Turn screen recordings into engaging product videos
products.summaryZh: 将屏幕录制转化为引人入胜的产品视频
products.descriptionZh: 将屏幕录制转化为精美的产品视频，自动实现动态缩放、AI配乐和聚光效果。
products.description: Turn screen recordings into polished product videos with automatic motion zoom, AI music, and spotlight effects.

products.name: Openmotion
products.tagline: Turn product screenshots and prompts into motion videos
products.summaryZh: 将产品截图和提示词转化为动态视频
products.descriptionZh: OpenMotion 是一款免费的 macOS 动效设计工作室，面向创始人、设计师和开发者。用简单英文描述一个场景，附上产品截图或品牌素材包，其 AI 代理即可生成可编辑的动效、产品发布及 SaaS 讲解视频。在真实画布和时间线上精修图层、时序、缓动、颜色、镜头和声音，然后导出 MP4。它兼容 Codex 和 Claude Code，无需单独的 API 密钥。
products.description: OpenMotion is a free macOS motion-design studio for founders, designers, and developers. Describe a scene in plain English, attach product screenshots or a brand kit, and its AI agent builds editable motion, product launch and SaaS explainer videos. Refine layers, timing, easing, colors, camera, and sound on a real canvas and timeline, then export MP4. It works with Codex and Claude Code, with no separate API keys.

products.name: Muse
products.tagline: Al Visual Bookmark Manager for Mac
products.summaryZh: Mac版AI视觉书签管理器
products.descriptionZh: Mac 版 AI 视觉书签管理器。它汇集你保存的所有内容——图片、截图、链接、视频和笔记——来自任何应用或浏览器标签页，并在你寻找时即刻呈现。所有内容由设备端 AI 自动标记和整理，完全存储在你的 Mac 上。一次性付费 29 美元，无订阅。30 天免费试用，无需绑定银行卡。
products.description: The AI Visual Bookmark Manager for Mac. It gathers everything you save - images, screenshots, links, video and notes - from any app or browser tab, and brings any of it back the instant you look for it. Everything is tagged and organised automatically by on-device AI, and stored entirely on your Mac. $29 once, no subscription. Free for 30 days, no card required.

products.name: min.
products.tagline: AI that loves to follow up after meetings
products.summaryZh: 热爱在会议后跟进的人工智能
products.descriptionZh: 我非常不擅长跟进他人。我制作了一个AI助手，它能在会议后以我的声音、带着全部背景信息替我进行跟进。
products.description: I'm really bad at following up with people. I made an AI assistant that follows up for me after a meeting in my voice, with all the context.

products.name: Port22
products.tagline: Claude Code, Codex & more on your phone
products.summaryZh: Claude Code、Codex 等，尽在您的手机
products.descriptionZh: 我会启动一个长时间的代理运行，然后离开，回来时发现它已经花了20分钟等我批准一个文件编辑。Port22将你Mac上运行的所有编码代理都带到手机上。查看哪些在工作，哪些卡住了。当某个代理需要权限时，你的手机会震动，你只需点击它实际提供的选项，而不是猜测按键。它连接到你已经在运行的内容。无需包装器，无需配置，无需新终端。免费支持一台Mac和两个会话，所有功能开启。
products.description: I'd start a long agent run, walk away, and come back to find it had spent 20 minutes waiting on me to approve one file edit. Port22 puts every coding agent running on your Mac onto your phone. See which are working and which are stuck. When one needs permission your phone buzzes and you tap the actual option it offered, not a guessed keystroke. It attaches to what you already run. No wrapper, no config, no new terminal. Free for one Mac and two sessions, every feature on.

products.name: Occasio®
products.tagline: Pinboard meets citation manager for shared insights.
products.summaryZh: Pinboard遇上文献管理工具，共享洞见。
products.descriptionZh: Occasio是您值得信赖的协作知识库，汇集恒久洞见。将复杂知识提炼为简明索引卡片，并以学术级引文严谨性关联来源。随着知识库增长，可分析趋势，无重复地策展无限组合。专为研究团队和思想领袖打造，他们坚守原创思维，对AI空话或虚构来源零容忍。
products.description: Occasio is your collaborative library of trusted, timeless insights. Distill complex knowledge onto bite-sized index cards and link sources with academic-grade citation rigour. As your library grows, analyse trends and curate endless combinations with zero duplication. Built for research teams and thought leaders who stand for original thinking and have zero tolerance for AI fluff or hallucinated sources.

products.name: Basedash Tasks
products.tagline: Run your business on autopilot
products.summaryZh: 让业务自动运行
products.descriptionZh: Tasks是一款面向业务的AI运营工具。它读取你的真实数据——收入、流失、激活、销售管道——并将其转化为一份按优先级排序的具体可执行任务清单：包括为何现在执行、预期结果以及分步指导。将任务复制到Linear或你的代理中，或通过Basedash代理启动。任务完成后，Basedash会追踪你的指标变化，并学习哪些做法真正有效。目前处于研究预览阶段。你的数据知道下一步该做什么——Tasks将其记录下来。
products.description: Tasks is an AI operator for your business. It reads your real data — revenue, churn, activation, pipeline — and turns it into a prioritized backlog of specific, actionable tasks: why now, the expected outcome, and step-by-step instructions. Copy a task into Linear or your agent, or kick it off with the Basedash agent. When it ships, Basedash tracks how your metrics move and learns what actually works. Now in research preview. Your data knows what to do next — Tasks writes it down.

products.name: Compass Calendar
products.tagline: The keyboard-first calendar to get organized quickly
products.summaryZh: 以键盘优先的日历，快速整理日程。
products.descriptionZh: Compass是一款简洁、以键盘操作为先的日历应用，旨在帮助你管理时间。它围绕vim风格的快捷键设计，让日程安排变得像玩俄罗斯方块一样有趣。如果你习惯于键盘操作并常驻日历之中，Compass将使你的生活更加便捷。尽管Compass以高效为核心，但有时最富有成效的事情是无所事事。因此，我们还提供了“生活”视图，将你的生活展示为点阵网格。这种视觉呈现有助于你过滤掉非必要事项。
products.description: Compass is a simple, keyboard-first calendar that helps you manage your time. It's built around vim-style shortcuts that make scheduling feel like a fun game of Tetris. If you live at the keyboard and in your calendar, Compass will make your life easier. Although Compass is built around speed, sometimes the most productive thing to do is nothing. That's why we also have a "life" view, which shows your life as a grid of dots. This visual will help you filter out non-essentials.

products.name: oxpecker
products.tagline: Know which of your lines a vendor just broke
products.summaryZh: 了解供应商刚刚破坏了你的哪条线路
products.descriptionZh: 六款产品将告诉你Stripe已改变。oxpecker告诉你它破坏了你的哪些代码行——在拉取请求上，在日落日期之前。68家供应商在关注；你的源代码从不离开你的CI。
products.description: Six products will tell you Stripe changed. oxpecker tells you which of your lines it broke — on the pull request, before the sunset date. 68 vendors watched; your source never leaves your CI.

products.name: Hoplite
products.tagline: Effortlessly deploy cloud software factories.
products.summaryZh: 轻松部署云软件工厂。
products.descriptionZh: Hoplite将您的本地编码代理配置部署到云端，无需重新配置。我们在接入过程中迁移您的会话、MCP服务器、依赖项和CLI，使您的代理能够从您离开的地方无缝继续。并行运行多个代理，无需担心笔记本电脑崩溃、git工作树管理或端口冲突。即时预览您的代理构建的所有内容。通过iMessage随时随地发起提示。
products.description: Hoplite deploys your local coding agent setup to the cloud, no reconfiguration needed. We migrate your sessions, MCP servers, dependencies, and CLIs during onboarding, so your agents pick up exactly where you left off. Run multiple agents in parallel without laptop crashes, git worktree wrangling, or port juggling. Instant previews of everything your agents build. Prompt from anywhere with iMessage.

products.name: Suno Studio 2.0
products.tagline: Browser-based generative DAW
products.summaryZh: 基于浏览器的生成式DAW
products.descriptionZh: Suno Studio 2.0 带来了 MIDI、音频效果、聊天、自动化等功能——你甚至可以设计自己的插件和合成器。
products.description: Suno Studio 2.0 brings MIDI, audio effects, chat, automation and more — you can even design your own plugins and synths.

products.name: NS1
products.tagline: Personalized Nervous System Training
products.summaryZh: 个性化神经系统训练
products.descriptionZh: NS1评估是一款个性化评估工具，可为您详细解析您的系统如何应对压力、这对您的具体情况意味着什么，以及您可以采取哪些改进措施。5分钟内，您将获得：- 调节评分：反映您系统在压力后恢复情况的现实基线- 五项技能评分卡：展示您在核心技能上的优势与成长空间- 个性化路径：一套结构化的学习旅程，旨在提升您的承受能力并重获主导权
products.description: The NS1 Assessment is a personalized assessment tool that will give you a breakdown of how your system responds to stress, what this means for your specific situation & what you can do to improve. In 5 minutes you'll receive: - Your regulation score: a realistic baseline of how well your system settles after stress - A five-skill scorecard: your strengths and growth edges across the core skills - A personalized path: a structured learning journey to increase your capacity and reclaim agency

products.name: ChordViz
products.tagline: Build your own music visualizer for MIDI & audio
products.summaryZh: 为MIDI与音频打造你自己的音乐可视化工具
products.descriptionZh: 音乐教师与创作者的视觉工作空间。将实时MIDI和音频转化为和弦、乐谱及音频反应视觉，并原生录制视频、音频或MIDI。支持流式输出至OBS、TouchDesigner和Resolume，用于现场演出。
products.description: The visual workspace for music teachers and creators. Turn live MIDI and audio into chord, notation and audio-reactive visuals then record video, audio or MIDI natively. Stream to OBS, TouchDesigner and Resolume for live performance.

products.name: Theos[RFM]
products.tagline: Manage facilities in 3D, in the real world, in real time
products.summaryZh: 在三维、现实世界和实时环境中管理设施。
products.descriptionZh: 我们的设施管理门户为业主、设施经理及其员工提供沉浸式协作3D体验。我们旨在革新人们管理设施的方式。
products.description: Our facility management portal provides an immersive and collaborative 3D experience for property owners, facility managers and their workers. We intend to revolutionize the way people manage their Facilities.
